podcast.body: One of two singles from "Michigan Left," this song was first performed live at the Olympics, where its initial rendition differed significantly from its final recorded version. It was considered the most aggressive track on the album, sharing the loud, fast rock characteristics of "Jackson Square." "I remember we played it live at the Olympics was the first time we ever played it live."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This track is from their 2011 album *Michigan Left* and was performed live at 102.1 The Edge in Toronto. "Arkels in a live version of Whistleblower, a track from their 2011 album Michigan Left."
